from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,signal,json
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='e0ba9a4fff99f926093f844f387ba0067a580cbe'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
code=r'''
import asyncio,json
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from tools.live_ats_inspect import allowed_url
from tools.ats_field_labels import extract_field_labels
from tools.ats_review_batch import build_review_batch
url="https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65/apply"
async def main():
 async with async_playwright() as pw:
  b=await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
  try:
   page=await b.new_page(accept_downloads=False)
   async def guard(route):
    if route.request.is_navigation_request() and not allowed_url(route.request.url):await route.abort()
    else:await route.continue_()
   await page.route("**/*",guard)
   response=await page.goto(url,wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=25000)
   await page.wait_for_timeout(2500)
   if not allowed_url(page.url):raise RuntimeError('UNAPPROVED_REDIRECT')
   fields=await extract_field_labels(page)
   result=build_review_batch(fields,{"full_name","email","phone"})
   review=result["human_review"]
   print(json.dumps({"http_status":response.status if response else None,"input_field_count":result["input_field_count"],"verified_candidate_count":len(result["verified_candidates"]),"review_item_count":result["review_item_count"],"required_review_items":sum(x["required"] for x in review),"optional_review_items":sum(not x["required"] for x in review),"grouped_multi_control_questions":sum(x["control_count"]>1 for x in review),"review_reasons":{k:sum(x["reason"]==k for x in review) for k in sorted({x["reason"] for x in review})},"no_submission":result["submission"],"auth":"not_attempted","fill":"not_attempted","review":"not_verified"},sort_keys=True))
  finally:await b.close()
asyncio.run(main())
'''
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',code],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=75)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('EXIT',p.returncode,'OUTPUT',o[-5500:],'ERROR',e[-650:],flush=True)
if p.returncode:raise SystemExit('LIVE_BATCH_VALIDATION_FAILED')
r=json.loads(o)
assert r['http_status']==200 and r['input_field_count']>0
assert r['review_item_count']+r['verified_candidate_count']<=r['input_field_count']
assert r['no_submission']=='not_attempted' and r['auth']=='not_attempted' and r['fill']=='not_attempted'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('LIVE_READONLY_REVIEW_BATCH_VERIFIED',flush=True)
